content.title: Scottie Scheffler Masters highlights: Score and first round results from Augusta
content.text: Updated April 9, 2026, 8:30 p.m. ETScottie Scheffler entered the 2026 Masters with some of the best shots in the sport in his bag as well as a world of expectations.Scheffler had himself a solid outing in the first round finishing with a 70 score after going 2 under par through 18 holes. He tied at sixth on the leaderboard with Xander Schauffele, Justin Rose and Shane Lowry."I did a good job of staying patient, playing smart, and tried to take advantage of a few opportunities that I had, but I probably get some really good punchline today and something that looked like they could have gone in that didn't," Scheffler said. "But overall, definitely pretty, pretty proud of the effort today."Leading the group through the opening round at Augusta was Sam Burns and reigning Masters champion Rory McIlroy.Scheffler wants to take back the Masters crown. The 29-year-old won at Augusta in 2022 and 2024. But patrons will walk this course fully expecting Scheffler to make it three victories in five years. He is currently the odds-on favorite to best a field that boasts the likes of past champions Jon Rahm and Rory McIlroy."It was very firm for a Thursday out there," he said. "We'll see how much they want to push it over the next few days. But yeah, I think when it comes to this golf course, a lot of us just wait and see. You know, it depends what Augusta wants to do with the setup. We'll see what happens."The fan favorite will have additional support from the gallery as his wife, Meredith, recently gave birth to their second son, Remy, who was born on March 27. Son Bennett was also present this week at the joyous Par 3 contest on Wednesday.Scheffler hadn't been able to pick up a golf club in roughly three weeks, but that didn't break any confidence he had going into the annual golf tourney."Not really. I was able to get some good games at home. I played play a lot of games at home. I played with Jordan [Spieth] a lot," Scheffler said when asked if his time away for his son's birth impacted his round. "I feel like I give my buddy so many strokes at home that that's always some high competition as well. So, yeah, I feel it feel like I'm in a good spot."USA TODAY Sports will have updates through the first round as Scottie Scheffler searches for another green jacket at the Masters:Scottie Scheffler tee time: Golfer start time, pairingsScheffler is part of one of the final groups to tee off on Thursday. Scottie Scheffler slides down the boardScottie Scheffler was making his way up the leaderboard, but he's since taken a dip. Through 16 holes, Scheffler has shot 2 under par. He fell to No. 7 on the leaderboard, as Justin Rose overtook No. 3 through 17 holes. Justin Day, Kurt Kitayama and Patrick Reed are all tied at No. 3. Scottie Scheffler moves near top of leaderboardIt's early at Augusta and the weather is warm. One golfer the field does not want getting hot is Scheffler. He came out of the gate with an eagle on No. 2 and followed that with a birdie on three and two subsequent pars. He is now just two behind leaders Rory McIlroy and Sam Burns, both at -5. Scheffler eagle on 2The world's best showed out early.
